description: This file defines the PropertyService interface in the package org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.springbatch, providing method signatures for retrieving batch job configuration properties based on job name.

classes.name: PropertyService
classes.description: Interface for accessing property configurations related to Spring Batch jobs, such as partition size, chunk size, retry limit, thread pool sizes, queue capacity, and poll interval.

methods.name: getPartitionSize
methods.description: Returns the partition size for the specified job.

methods.name: getChunkSize
methods.description: Returns the chunk size for the specified job.

methods.name: getRetryLimit
methods.description: Returns the retry limit for the specified job.

methods.name: getThreadPoolCorePoolSize
methods.description: Returns the thread pool core size for the specified job.

methods.name: getThreadPoolMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the thread pool maximum size for the specified job.

methods.name: getThreadPoolQueueCapacity
methods.description: Returns the thread pool queue capacity for the specified job.

methods.name: getPollInterval
methods.description: Returns the poll interval for the specified job.
